findings.evidence: `Algebra.TensorProduct.map` at mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/TensorProduct/Maps.lean:536; `toLinearMap_map (f) (g) : (map f g).toLinearMap = TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.map f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap := rfl` at line 540, and `AlgHom.toLinearMap_id : (AlgHom.id R A).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := rfl` at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Hom.lean:300 — exactly the body at FiniteSeparable.lean:113-115.

summary: The main theorem is new material, but the file carries two private copies of Mathlib's `Algebra.TensorProduct.map` (as a linear map and as a ring hom) plus ~40 lines of scaffolding proving they agree and re-deriving `map_one`/`map_mul`/`map_tmul`, and it re-proves base-change injectivity and a matrix-unit `map` computation that Mathlib lemmas already give.
